facts.content: In repo:example/cache, configure the quartz cache with a 90-second TTL to expire stale entries.
Configure the quartz cache in repo:example/cache to expire stale entries by setting its TTL to 90 seconds.
In repo:example/cache, set the quartz cache TTL to 90 seconds to expire stale entries.
In repo:example/ledger, the copper ledger exporter writes TSV files with a tab delimiter.
On 2026-10-03, repo:example/ledger replaced the copper ledger exporter; it now writes CSV files with a comma delimiter instead of TSV with tabs.
In repo:example/search, when the indigo indexer reports a stale shard, restart the indigo indexer to restore shard reads.
In repo:example/search, the deployed fix 8ac41f eliminated the indigo indexer's stale-shard bug; restarting the indigo indexer is no longer needed to restore shard reads.
In repo:example/backup, rotate the cobalt backup key every 30 days using the vaultctl command.
In repo:example/backup, rotate the cobalt backup key every 30 days with vaultctl rotate --key cobalt, then verify the fingerprint with vaultctl show --fingerprint.
On host:cedar, the amber relay listens on port 7441 and sends amber relay heartbeats every 20 seconds.
On host:maple, the amber relay listens on port 7441 and sends amber relay heartbeats every 20 seconds.
In repo:example/queue, the saffron queue worker uses a batch size of 40 messages.
In repo:example/queue, the saffron queue worker uses a batch size of 60 messages.
In repo:example/web, the jade renderer caches compiled jade templates for 15 minutes.
In repo:example/worker, the jade renderer caches compiled jade templates for 15 minutes.
The completed experiment selected the plum menu for a one-off preview; it recorded no reusable result.
During the violet banner contrast check in the dashboard preview I nudged the heading two pixels left. The test overlay was discarded when the preview closed.
The violet banner contrast check in the dashboard preview requires loading the high-contrast palette before opening the heading overlay.
The fuchsia parser behaved strangely around the sample input; the cause and any lasting implication are unknown.
